title.zh: 會計營運與內控合規匯報 (CAO/財務總監視角)

slide_title.zh: 營運脈絡與會計轉型訴求 (SCQA & The Ask)

zh: 情境 (Situation)：隨著業務跨國擴張與交易模式複雜化，我們的營收規模正快速成長
衝突 (Complication)：然而，高度依賴人工的結帳流程與舊 ERP 系統，導致財報產出嚴重遞延，並增加查核風險
戰略訴求 (The Ask)：會計團隊必須從「記帳員」轉型為「數據守門員」，懇請核准 [X 預算] 啟動帳務自動化與內控升級
en: Situation: As our business expands globally and transaction models increase in complexity, revenue is scaling rapidly.
Complication: However, heavy reliance on manual closing processes and legacy ERP systems causes severe reporting delays and audit risks.
Strategic Ask: Accounting must evolve from 'bookkeepers' to 'data gatekeepers'. Requesting [X Budget] for automation and internal control upgrades.

speaker_notes.zh: 各位長官/審計委員好。隨著公司業務狂奔，我們的會計後勤已經到了極限。過去我們依賴大量人工核對與 Excel 來結帳，這不僅讓管理層拿到財報的時間太慢，更隱藏了極大的錯帳風險。今天的提案，是為了推動會計流程自動化，確保我們的財報既快速又絕對精準。
speaker_notes.en: Good morning, Board and Audit Committee. As the business scales, our accounting back-office is stretched to its limit. Relying on manual reconciliation and Excel not only delays the delivery of financial statements to management but also conceals significant error risks. Today's pitch is about automating the accounting workflow to ensure our reporting is both rapid and bulletproof.

slide_title.zh: 結帳加速與 RPA 自動化 (Fast Close & Automation)

zh: 現狀痛點 (The Bottleneck)：目前月底結帳天數 (Days to Close) 需耗時 [X] 天，嚴重落後業界標竿
自動化導入 (RPA & ERP)：提議導入機器人流程自動化 (RPA)，取代 [X]% 的重複性傳票切立與跨行對帳
效率回報 (ROI of Fast Close)：預期將結帳週期縮短至 [X] 天，讓高層能提早 [X] 天取得決策數據
en: The Bottleneck: Our current month-end close takes [X] days, lagging significantly behind industry benchmarks.
Automation (RPA): Propose deploying Robotic Process Automation (RPA) to eliminate [X]% of repetitive journal entries and bank reconciliations.
ROI of Fast Close: Projecting a reduction of the close cycle to [X] days, delivering actionable data to management [X] days earlier.

speaker_notes.zh: 在瞬息萬變的市場，『慢的數據就是沒用的數據』。我們目前結帳需要 X 天，這太慢了。我們提議導入 RPA (流程自動化) 來處理那些高度重複的對帳工作。這不僅能釋放會計人員的產能，更能達成『結帳加速 (Fast Close)』，讓決策層提早拿到數據。
speaker_notes.en: In a volatile market, 'slow data is useless data'. Our current close takes X days, which is unacceptable. We propose implementing RPA to handle highly repetitive reconciliations. This not only frees up accounting bandwidth but achieves a 'Fast Close', putting critical data in management's hands much earlier.

slide_title.zh: 內部控制與查核防禦 (Internal Controls & Audit Readiness)

zh: 合規現狀 (Compliance Baseline)：遵循 [IFRS/GAAP] 準則，本季度無重大缺失 (Material Weakness)
內控強化 (SOX/COSO 框架)：針對高風險的 [存貨盤點/營收認列] 流程，強制導入系統級的三方比對 (3-Way Match)
查核防禦 (Audit Readiness)：從「事後補救」轉為「持續性稽核 (Continuous Audit)」，降低外部會計師查核成本
en: Compliance Baseline: Adhering strictly to [IFRS/GAAP] standards, reporting zero Material Weaknesses this quarter.
Control Fortification (COSO): Enforcing system-level 3-Way Matching for high-risk processes like [Inventory/Revenue Recognition].
Audit Readiness: Shifting from 'reactive remediation' to 'Continuous Auditing', significantly reducing external auditor fees.

speaker_notes.zh: 會計的核心價值是『防禦風險』。我們嚴格遵循 IFRS/GAAP 規範，並導入 COSO 內控框架。針對容易出錯的營收認列與採購，我們將人工防堵升級為系統強制的三方比對。透過建立『隨時可受稽』的體質，我們能大幅降低外部會計師的查核風險與費用。
speaker_notes.en: The core value of Accounting is 'Risk Defense'. We strictly adhere to IFRS/GAAP and the COSO framework. For error-prone areas like revenue recognition and procurement, we are upgrading from manual checks to system-enforced 3-way matching. By maintaining an 'audit-ready' posture, we drastically reduce external auditor risks and fees.

slide_title.zh: 稅務戰略與價值保護 (Tax Strategy & Value Preservation)

zh: 稅務優化 (Tax Optimization)：合法運用 [研發投資抵減/特定法規]，本年度預計節省 [X] 稅務支出
移轉訂價風險 (Transfer Pricing)：針對跨國交易，已委託外部顧問出具移轉訂價報告，防堵 [某國] 的稅務稽查風險
現金流保護 (Working Capital)：優化應收/應付帳款 (AR/AP) 入帳時效，保護公司營運資金的水位
en: Tax Optimization: Legally leveraging [R&D Tax Credits/Specific Regulations] to save an estimated [X] in tax liabilities this year.
Transfer Pricing: Commissioned external TP reports for cross-border transactions to neutralize tax audit risks in [Region].
Working Capital Protection: Optimizing AR/AP booking efficiency to actively protect our enterprise cash reserves.

speaker_notes.zh: 會計不僅是記帳，更是替公司『守財』。在稅務戰略上，我們主動申請各項合法的投資抵減，直接為公司省下真金白銀。針對跨國業務，我們也提前做好了移轉訂價的防禦。透過精準的帳務管理，我們實質保護了公司的現金流與企業價值。
speaker_notes.en: Accounting is not just bookkeeping; it's about 'Value Preservation'. Strategically, we are aggressively pursuing legal tax credits, directly saving the company hard cash. For our global operations, we've preemptively fortified our transfer pricing documentation. Through precise ledger management, we actively protect our cash flow and enterprise value.

slide_title.zh: 次步行動與決策訴求 (Next Steps & Capital Ask)

zh: 90 天里程碑 (First 90 Days)：完成 [舊系統] 資料清洗，並上線 RPA 自動化對帳模組 (Quick Win)
查核時程 (Audit Timeline)：將於 [日期] 提交年度財報草案，並配合四大會計師事務所展開實地查核
決策訴求 (Call to Action)：懇請審計委員會核准 [X 預算]，以完成會計流程自動化的最後一哩路
en: 90-Day Milestones: Complete data cleansing in [Legacy System] and launch the RPA reconciliation module (Quick Win).
Audit Timeline: Submitting the draft annual financials by [Date] and commencing fieldwork with the Big 4 auditors.
Call to Action: Requesting the Audit Committee's approval for [X Budget] to complete the final mile of our accounting automation.

speaker_notes.zh: 最後是我們的 90 天落地計畫與查核時程表。為了確保年底的財報能夠又快又準地交付給外部會計師，我們必須立刻啟動自動化模組的建置。這筆預算不是花費，而是降低合規風險、提升決策速度的必要投資。懇請審計委員會核准。
speaker_notes.en: Finally, here is our 90-day roadmap and audit schedule. To ensure we deliver fast and accurate year-end financials to our external auditors, we must initiate the automation build-out immediately. This budget isn't an expense; it's a mandatory investment in risk reduction and decision speed. We respectfully request the Audit Committee's approval.

prompt_template.zh: 請以繁體中文製作一份大師級的『會計營運與內控合規』簡報。受眾為審計委員會、CFO 或董事會。內容必須展現 CAO (首席會計官) 或 Financial Controller 的專業與嚴謹度：1. 運用 SCQA 架構點出『業務成長』與『舊會計流程』的衝突，2. 強調結帳加速 (Fast Close) 與 RPA 自動化的效益 (ROI)，3. 深入內部控制 (COSO/SOX) 與查核防禦 (Audit Readiness)，絕不能流於流水帳，4. 帶入稅務戰略 (Tax Strategy) 與移轉訂價 (Transfer Pricing) 的價值保護觀念，5. 結尾給出明確的查核時程與自動化系統升級預算請求。每張 Slide 不超過 3 個重點，語氣需極具合規權威感、數據絕對精準，並展現為公司『守護價值』的強大決心。
prompt_template.en: Please create a master-class 'Accounting Operations & Internal Controls' presentation in English. Audience: Audit Committee, CFO, or Board of Directors. Demonstrate CAO/Financial Controller level rigor: 1. Use SCQA to highlight the clash between 'Business Scaling' and 'Legacy Accounting Processes'. 2. Emphasize the ROI of achieving a 'Fast Close' and RPA Automation. 3. Dive deep into Internal Controls (COSO/SOX) and Audit Readiness—strictly avoid mundane bookkeeping lists. 4. Incorporate Tax Strategy, Transfer Pricing, and Value Preservation. 5. Conclude with a clear audit timeline and a specific budget ask for system automation. Max 3 bullet points per slide. The tone must exude compliance authority, absolute data precision, and a fierce commitment to protecting enterprise value.
